findings.title: Avoid buffering unused ping output
findings.impact: Every call stores stdout and stderr in memory even though the helper only checks the return code. With a large count or a noisy ping implementation, this does unnecessary allocation and copy work on an operator path.
findings.fix: Redirect stdout and stderr to subprocess.DEVNULL, and consider bounding count to a small operationally useful maximum if this helper can be called from loops or automation.

fun reviewPerformancePr() {
  val planTools = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val plannedReview = compute(planTools)
  val dimension = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/dimension.txt")
  val rubric = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/rubric.md")
  val pr = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
  val diff = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val repoReadme = readRepoFile(".repo_context/README.md")
  val repoIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/index.md")
  val maintenance = readRepoFile(".repo_context/maintenance.md")
  val generatedIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
  val engineeringPrinciples = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val selfVerification = readRepoFile(".repo_context/playbooks/upkeep/ai-self-verification.md")
  val reviewChecklist = readRepoFile(".repo_context/playbooks/reviews/pr-review-checklist.md")
  val evidence = compute(plannedReview, dimension, rubric, pr, diff, repoReadme, repoIndex, maintenance, generatedIndex, engineeringPrinciples, selfVerification, reviewChecklist)
  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
  publish("safeoutputs:noop", "Review evidence written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json; no GitHub issue was needed because the review result is carried by the evidence file.")
}
